entities.summary: Alberto Burri was an Italian visual artist, painter, sculptor, and physician based in Città di Castello. He is associated with the matterism of the European informal art movement and described his style as a polymaterialist. He had connections with Lucio Fontana's spatialism and, with Antoni Tàpies, an influence on the revival of the art of post-war assembly in the United States as in Europe. Alberto Burri was a painters & sculptors from Città di Castello (1915-03-12, Città di Castello–1995-02-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Burri's matterism influenced the revival of post-war assembly in Europe and the US, with his work being exhibited alongside Lucio Fontana and Antoni Tàpies. His style also connected to spatialism.
